scientific_limitations: One-dimensional symmetric stable noise with 1<alpha<2; positive linear friction/restoring coefficients; nonoscillatory masses 0<m<=gamma^2/(4*kappa). Earlier work contains the stable-kernel integral, and wider gamma quotient inequalities may imply the auxiliary sign comparison. No claim for nonlinear drift, oscillatory masses, or alpha<=1.
title: Strict inertial inflation of stationary stable-oscillator positions and a sharp small-mass rate
